items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: He was singing at Tom Anderson's, right at Iberville and Ramport.

ctx.x: No, I never, a singer? Singer, yeah. New Orleans, they call it New Orleans Willie Jackson. Yeah, Willie Jackson.
He was singing at Tom Anderson's, right at Iberville and Ramport.
Did you ever work at Tom Anderson's too?

items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: But he and Willie Jackson used to be partners. That's right.

ctx.x: I don't know. In the band or? No. By himself. In Newky. You know Newky?
The singer? Yeah. Newky Johnson. I don't know. That's his name. But he and Willie Jackson used to be partners. That's right.
